MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The bar magnets felt useful because I recently chose magnetic hooks twice, and these offer a related way to mount small objects.",
    "Their magnetic attachment function fits my recent interests, although the lack of hooks makes their usefulness less certain."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Casters and a mobile base relate to my older dolly purchase, but I have no current replacement or equipment-moving need.",
    "Wire connectors require a wiring project; buying screws and locking washers does not mean I need electrical supplies.",
    "The drain plug, thermometer, restroom dispenser, and printed masks serve needs I have not expressed, while twelve tubes of glue would require an adhesive project I do not currently have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My hardware purchases seem to have been treated as interest in almost any workshop or maintenance product.",
    "My older dolly purchase seems to have been taken as an ongoing need for more equipment-moving accessories."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My two recent magnetic hook purchases make hanging and magnetic attachment more relevant than unrelated tools.",
    "The job an item performs matters more to me than whether it comes in an assortment like my screws and washers.",
    "I rarely choose something without a clear current use; a possible future repair or project is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in magnetic attachment but stretched my hardware purchases into needs for unrelated projects."
}
